edits.new:
# Hierarchical Bayesian binomial-beta model fitted with RStan
library(rstan)

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = min(4, parallel::detectCores()))

dat <- read.csv("/app/data.csv")
stan_data <- list(N = nrow(dat), y = as.integer(dat$y), n = as.integer(dat$n))

model <- stan_model(file = "/app/hierarchical_model.stan")

# Build the argument list defensively: some rstan versions differ in the
# kwargs accepted by sampling(); keep only those that exist in the signature.
args <- list(
  object  = model,
  data    = stan_data,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 100000,
  warmup  = 50000,
  seed    = 1,
  refresh = 0,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
fmls <- try(names(formals(getMethod("sampling", "stanmodel"))), silent = TRUE)
if (!inherits(fmls, "try-error") && !("..." %in% fmls)) {
  args <- args[names(args) %in% fmls]
}
fit <- tryCatch(do.call(rstan::sampling, args),
                error = function(e) do.call(rstan::sampling,
                                            args[c("object", "data", "chains", "iter", "warmup", "seed")]))

posterior <- rstan::extract(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta"))
alpha_mean <- mean(posterior$alpha)
beta_mean  <- mean(posterior$beta)

cat(sprintf("posterior mean alpha: %.6f\n", alpha_mean))
cat(sprintf("posterior mean beta:  %.6f\n", beta_mean))
print(summary(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta"))$summary)

writeLines(format(alpha_mean, digits = 10), "/app/posterior_alpha_mean.txt")
writeLines(format(beta_mean, digits = 10), "/app/posterior_beta_mean.txt")

cd /app && cat > /tmp/grid.R <<'EOF'
d <- read.csv("data.csv"); y<-d$y; n<-d$n; cat(nrow(d), sum(y), sum(n), mean(y/n), "\n")
lp <- function(u,v){ lam<-exp(v); p<-1/(1+exp(-u)); a<-p*lam; b<-(1-p)*lam
  sum(lbeta(a+y, b+n-y) - lbeta(a,b)) - 2.5*v + 2*v + log(p) + log1p(-p) }
us <- seq(-8,2,length.out=1200); vs <- seq(-3,12,length.out=1200)
G <- outer(us, vs, Vectorize(lp))
G <- G - max(G); W <- exp(G); W <- W/sum(W)
lam <- exp(vs); p <- 1/(1+exp(-us))
A <- outer(p,lam); B <- outer(1-p,lam)
cat("alpha mean:", sum(W*A), " beta mean:", sum(W*B), "\n")
cat("tail mass check:", sum(W[1,]), sum(W[nrow(W),]), sum(W[,1]), sum(W[,ncol(W)]), "\n")
EOF
Rscript /tmp/grid.R
cd /app && time Rscript analysis.R 2>&1 | tail -12; echo ---; cat posterior_alpha_mean.txt posterior_beta_mean.txt
